protocol.name: niri_blur_shape_v1

description.summary: precise rounded/superellipse blur shapes for surfaces

protocol.description: Allows clients to submit exact floating-point (wl_fixed) rounded or superellipse rectangle arrays for surface background blur, overriding ext_background_effect_surface_v1.set_blur_region when active.

description.summary: manager for per-surface precise blur shapes

entry.name: blur_shape_exists
entry.summary: wl_surface already has a niri_blur_shape_surface_v1 object

request.name: destroy
request.description: This has no effect on existing niri_blur_shape_surface_v1 objects.

request.name: get_surface

description.summary: create a blur shape object for a surface

request.description: Creates a niri_blur_shape_surface_v1 object for the given wl_surface. If the wl_surface already has an active niri_blur_shape_surface_v1 object, the blur_shape_exists protocol error is raised.

interface.name: niri_blur_shape_surface_v1
interface.description: Double-buffered blur shape state for a wl_surface. All requests mutate pending state and take effect on the next wl_surface.commit.

request.name: destroy

description.summary: destroy the blur shape surface object

request.description: Unsets any pending blur shapes on the associated surface (effective on the next commit) and destroys this object.

request.name: clear

description.summary: clear pending blur shapes to an empty list

request.description: Sets the pending blur shape state to an explicit empty list (suppressing fallback to ext_background_effect_v1) so subsequent add_rounded_rect calls build a fresh list for this commit.

request.name: add_rounded_rect

description.summary: append a rounded or superellipse rectangle

request.description: Appends a rounded/superellipse rectangle in surface-local logical coordinates (wl_fixed, 1/256 logical pixel precision) to the pending blur shape list. Clients should submit non-overlapping shapes; overlapping shapes are composited sequentially in submission order.

request.name: unset

description.summary: unset blur shapes and allow fallback

request.description: Clears the pending blur shape override so the surface falls back to ext_background_effect_v1 / compositor rules on the next commit.
